title: room.join
description: client → server. A phone joins a room as a player or as a spectator. No account and no personal data: only a nickname and an avatar. The server answers room.joined followed by the snapshot. A PLAYER request becomes a spectator with pendingPlayer = true when the Build phase has started (late join) or when all 10 slots are taken.

room.description: Room code typed or taken from the `room` URL parameter, upper-cased.

as.description: PLAYER, or SPECTATOR when the URL has `watch=1`.

nickname.description: Requested nickname, before server normalisation. Required when `as` = PLAYER; ignored for SPECTATOR.

avatar.description: Requested avatar. Required when `as` = PLAYER; ignored for SPECTATOR.

prefs.description: Device preferences; defaults (all false, 100 %, haptics true, lang from `hello`) when missing.

Avatar.description: Player avatar (§3.1): astronaut suit colour and patch, both cosmetic ids.

DataId.description: Identifier of an entry in the shared game data (`data/`): part, part category, contract, test, anomaly card, minigame, fact, codex entry, callout, console request, award, objective, validation rule, cosmetic. 1–48 characters.

LangTag.description: BCP 47 language tag, lower-case primary subtag (e.g. "en", "ar", "pt-BR").

PlayerPrefs.description: Per-device accessibility and language preferences (§16). Set by each phone, relayed to the host and all clients inside `room.state`.

relaxed.description: Motor: Relaxed minigame mode (wider timing windows).

reducedMotion.description: Motion: no shake, fewer particles, no flashing.

RoomCode.description: Room code: exactly 4 upper-case letters from A–Z without I and O (24-letter alphabet). Clients upper-case user input before sending.
